name: hivemind
description: Shared, versioned knowledge graph + artifact store + tool registry that REPLACES local agent memory: read it before any work, persist all work into it.

server_url.title: Hivemind server URL
server_url.description: Your Hivemind server, used as ${server_url}/mcp. Two forms work. WITH a project path (http://<host>:8787/p/default) the URL names the project, so calls that omit project= act in it. WITHOUT one (http://<host>:8787) every call must pass project= — reads as well as writes — which is stricter and needs a token minted with --user. Keep the project path unless you have a reason not to: the SessionStart hook exports this value as HIVEMIND_SERVER_URL for the session, and the live guide and the hivemind CLI both need a project base to reach /guide and /blobs.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Bearer token from `hivemind-admin mint-token --user <you> --device <machine>`, kept in the server's identities.json. It names a person, which is what puts an author on your writes, and it reaches every project that person may access. An older per-project token (the server's tokens.json) still works, but only with the project-path form of the URL above.
